user.title: Add an Age of Empires II player
user.description:
Track a player's ratings and recent matches. Data is provided by [aoe2companion]({data_source_url}).

This is an unofficial integration, not affiliated with aoe2companion or the makers of Age of Empires II.

data_description.profile_id: The number at the end of the player's profile address on [aoe2companion]({data_source_url}), for example 196240.

reconfigure.title: Change player
reconfigure.description:
Track a different player with this entry. Data is provided by [aoe2companion]({data_source_url}).

Changing the player replaces this entry's entities with ones for the new player.

data_description.profile_id: The number at the end of the player's profile address on [aoe2companion]({data_source_url}), for example 196240.

error.player_not_found: No player has this profile ID.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the data source. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This player has already been added.

init.title: Update intervals
init.description: How often to check for new ratings and matches. Shorter intervals show results sooner but put more load on the data source.

data_description.update_minutes: Minutes between checks when the player is not in a match. Minimum {min_update_minutes}.
data_description.in_match_update_minutes: Minutes between checks while the player is in a match. Minimum {min_in_match_update_minutes}.
